statement_summary: Program meets the HIPAA Security Rule and is documented
Security Officer designated in writing
Annual enterprise risk analysis using SP 800-30
Risk acceptance authority by level; no patient-safety risk accepted above Low
Quarterly reporting to the audit committee
Annual policy and standard review
Written, time-limited exceptions
HIPAA sanctions
No BAA, no PHI; purchasing gate
Annual reassessment of Tier 1 vendors
Annual independent evaluation
Six-year retention of security documentation
AI tools approved through AI governance before use
Unique accounts; documented exceptions for device consoles
Role-based least-privilege access with approval
MFA for all; phishing-resistant MFA for administrators
Same-day IdP disable at termination; badges and local accounts within 24 hours
Remove prior-role access within 5 business days of transfer
Quarterly access reviews; quarterly privileged and export rights review
Separate privileged accounts, just-in-time elevation, no standing vendor domain admin
Lockout, screen lock, and EHR session timeout
Break-glass accounts per critical system, tested quarterly
Password rules; vaulted service accounts; default credentials changed
Vendor remote access through the broker, per-session approval, recorded
Runbooks for ransomware and vendor outage
Report suspected incidents within 1 hour
Log incidents and record discovery time
Crisis management team within 2 hours for severity 1
Four-factor breach assessment in the decision log
Meet notification deadlines with counsel confirmation
Insurer hotline before engaging vendors
Ransom decision: CEO, counsel, insurer, OFAC check, law enforcement report
ASC emergency plan activation decision during incidents
Annual exercise per runbook; ASC cyber scenario
Lessons learned within 30 days
Four-level classification
Encrypt Restricted data at rest and in transit
Company-managed keys; separate backup keys
Restricted data only in approved systems
Restricted data and device inventory reconciled quarterly
Certified sanitization, including leased modalities
Isolated immutable backups, restore-tested quarterly
No Restricted data in unapproved AI tools
Retention schedule
Annual acknowledgment
Annual training, monthly reminders, quarterly phishing, role-based training
Screen lock and screen positioning
No unapproved software or USB storage
Approved AI tools only; human review of AI outputs
All-party consent before AI scribe recording
Job-based record lookup; access analytics
